title: [AdvancedChatBox] Simply Updated
description: An update of the original AdvancedChatBox(With fixes). Complex suggestions, spell check, and tab completion added in the Minecraft chat box
body:
# AdvancedChatBox
THIS IS AN UPDATED PORT FROM THE [ORIGINAL](https://modrinth.com/mod/advancedchatbox) BY [DarkKronicle](https://modrinth.com/user/DarkKronicle)!

AdvancedChatBox allows for complex suggestions and tab completion to be added into the Minecraft chat box.

Please submit bugs to the [issue tracker](https://github.com/Nordes314/AdvancedChatBox/issues).
## Dependencies

[[AdvancedChatCore] Simply Updated](https://modrinth.com/mod/advancedchatcore-simply-updated) is required for this mod to work.
## Features

- Spelling Checker powered by [LanguageTool](https://languagetool.org/de)
- In-Chat Calculator
- Toggle player tab suggestions
- Add custom chat suggestions in the form of shortcuts
- Change the color of the suggestors
- Custom command highlighting
- Built-in JSON linter for commands
- Legacy color code formatting when typing messages
  
## Credits n' more
